regression_formulas.add_month: wc_pp ~ snr_pct + log_J + log_n + log_sigma + C(month)
regression_formulas.flexible_controls: wc_pp ~ snr_pct + C(n_arms) + bs(log_n, df=4) + bs(log_sigma, df=4)

curve_formulas.snr_pct: wc_pp ~ bs(snr_pct, df=5) + log_J + log_n + log_sigma
curve_formulas.total_impressions: wc_pp ~ bs(log_total, df=5) + log_J + snr_pct + log_sigma

flexible_adjusted_formulas.snr_decile: wc_pp ~ C(snr_decile) + C(n_arms) + bs(log_n, df=4) + bs(log_sigma, df=4)
flexible_adjusted_formulas.total_decile: wc_pp ~ C(total_decile) + C(n_arms) + bs(snr_pct, df=4) + bs(log_sigma, df=4)
flexible_adjusted_formulas.arm_group: wc_pp ~ C(arm_group) + bs(snr_pct, df=4) + bs(log_n, df=4) + bs(log_sigma, df=4)

uncertainty: Pointwise normal 95% intervals using finite-sample-adjusted calendar-week cluster covariance; separate HC3 regression checks. No estimator-bias guarantee.
sigma_definition: sqrt(pooled test CTR * (1 - pooled test CTR)); SNR uses the notebook top-two outcome SD definition.
risk_proxy: Earliest package created_at in [2013-06-25, 2014-01-11) UTC. Official problem flags are absent from the saved input.
interpretation: OLS standardization to the full-sample covariate distribution, with potential extrapolation; descriptive, not causal.
